text:
Eat breakfast inside the gates, lunch on the Karasuma side and dinner eleven floors up. Here's how a day of eating works at Kyoto Station, hour by hour, so you never waste a meal on a sad sandwich 👇

🌅 6:00

Honke Daiichi Asahi opens its doors, ramen since 1947. A line forms before opening; 9:00 to 10:00 is calmer. Closed Thursdays.

🚆 6:30

Shiokoji Cafe, inside the JR Central gate by Platform 0: a Japanese breakfast set for under ¥1,000. You don't even leave the gates.

🍜 9:00

Shinpuku Saikan, next door to Daiichi Asahi, started as a street stall in 1938. Chuka soba ¥950, plus the fried rice. Cash only.

🍛 Lunch

Kyoto curry udon at Mimikou, right by the subway's Karasuma East gate.

🍵 Evening

Isetan 11F: dashi chazuke at Kyoto Obuya (about ¥1,100), or tofu and yuba from Fujino's own factory in Tango.

⚠️ From 14 December 2026, three other Isetan 11F restaurants close for station works.

🔎 Insider check: there are two ramen shops called Daiichi Asahi. The 1947 original has 本家 ("the original house") on its sign.

Save this for your Kyoto day. Which meal would you plan your day around?
